'''Kyong Won-ha''' ({{Korean|hangul=경원하}}; born 1928) is a [[nuclear scientist]] who may have participated in developing the [[North Korean nuclear program]].<ref name=theage/>

According to a 2003 report, he left North Korea in 2002 with help from Spanish officials, ultimately defecting to the [[United States]].<ref name=theage>{{cite news |last=Green |first=Shane |title=Debate on nuclear 'defector' |date=April 24, 2003 |work=[[The Age]] |url=https://www.theage.com.au/national/debate-on-nuclear-defector-20030424-gdvlbc.html}}</ref>
